All figures are secondary-source market prices; every data point has a source link and a date, taken from the source where it gives one and marked where it does not. Wattlyst does not sell solar equipment.

p: Installed prices include panels, inverter, structure, cables, protection and labour. An on-grid {{ds.og10.kw|int}} kW system was listed at {{ds.og10.low_rs|rsm}} to {{ds.og10.high_rs|rsm}} ({{ds.og10.sources|int}} sources) and a {{ds.og5.kw|int}} kW system at {{ds.og5.low_rs|rsm}} to {{ds.og5.high_rs|rsm}}. Hybrid systems carry a battery, so their range depends on battery size more than on panel count.

Sizes backed by a single source are listed with a source count of one: treat those as a rough guide. Use the solar system price calculator to estimate any size between the listed ones and the quote checker to compare a written quote.

Panels are priced per watt: {{ds.panel.low|rsm}} to {{ds.panel.high|rsm}} for Tier-1 N-type modules. Hybrid inverters cost {{ds.hybrid_inverter_6.low|rsm}} to {{ds.hybrid_inverter_6.high|rsm}} at 6 kW and {{ds.hybrid_inverter_10.low|rsm}} to {{ds.hybrid_inverter_10.high|rsm}} at 10 kW. A 5 kWh lithium (LiFePO4) pack costs {{ds.lithium_battery_5.low|rsm}} to {{ds.lithium_battery_5.high|rsm}} and a 12 V tubular battery {{ds.tubular_battery_12.low|rsm}} to {{ds.tubular_battery_12.high|rsm}}.
Equipment prices are retail list prices without installation. They move with the rupee, import duties and sales tax on solar equipment, which is why the tracker is dated and refreshed monthly.

Each month Wattlyst collects current price ranges from Pakistani dealer price lists, installer price guides and news reports. For a size with four or more sources the range is the median of the sources' lows and highs; with fewer sources it is the lowest low and the highest high, so a single source keeps its full range. Obvious data errors and single-figure sources are excluded and the reason is recorded. Prices are dated where the source gives a date; where it does not, the date shown is the one we could infer (for example from the page's image paths) or the day we found it, and the source list says which. Some sources date from earlier in the year rather than this month, so check each one's date in the list below.
The previous month's figures are frozen before the new month replaces them, so the CSV becomes a price history. Corrections go to the contact page.

faq.q: How much does a {{ds.og10.kw|int}} kW solar system cost in Pakistan?
faq.a: About {{ds.og10.low_rs|rsm}} to {{ds.og10.high_rs|rsm}} installed for an on-grid system and {{ds.hy10.low_rs|rsm}} to {{ds.hy10.high_rs|rsm}} for a hybrid system with a battery.

faq.q: How much is a lithium battery for solar?
faq.a: A 5 kWh (51.2 V, 100 Ah) LiFePO4 pack is listed at {{ds.lithium_battery_5.low|rsm}} to {{ds.lithium_battery_5.high|rsm}}. Compare the warranty years and cycle rating, not only the price.

faq.q: Are solar prices going up or down?
faq.a: The tracker started this month, so there is no month-on-month change yet; from next month each table shows the change. Panel prices move with the dollar rate and with any change in sales tax on solar equipment.

faq.q: Can I use these prices in an article?
faq.a: Yes, under CC BY 4.0: credit Wattlyst and link to this page. Download the CSV for every figure with its source count and date.
